courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 哥本哈根阿邁厄巴克焚化發電廠
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public facility/research reference, not an operating entrance or the teaching laboratory.

courses.summary: 工程承包商DEME記錄倫敦奧運場址的土壤整治與材料回用；本課以EPA土壤清洗機理分析污染在細料及洗水間的轉移。
courses.summaryEn: Contractor DEME documents soil remediation and material reuse at the London Olympic site; the lesson uses EPA soil-washing principles to analyze transfer into fines and washwater.

history.title: 倫敦奧林匹克公園棕地整治
history.text: 工程承包商DEME記錄倫敦奧運場址的土壤整治與材料回用；本課以EPA土壤清洗機理分析污染在細料及洗水間的轉移。
history.textEn: Contractor DEME documents soil remediation and material reuse at the London Olympic site; the lesson uses EPA soil-washing principles to analyze transfer into fines and washwater.

courses.connection: 以倫敦奧運場址整治為參考，先建立土壤—地下水概念模型，再追蹤粒級、洗水、殘渣與合格回填批次。土地變綠不能代替污染物驗收。
courses.connectionEn: Using the London Olympic site as a reference, build a soil-groundwater conceptual model and trace size fractions, washwater, residuals and accepted backfill. Green appearance does not replace contaminant acceptance.
